journal_definition: Native metric values averaged over eight local scene slots; conditional means divide by actual enabled fraction. Ratios of means are not norms of summed gradients.

protocol.PG_EMA_initialization: first strictly positive actual PG norm
protocol.clock: eligible per-rank teacher-slot loss calls, including inner reuse; not Adam updates
protocol.cold_start: PG and PG EMA both zero: minimum scales, probe again next call, no eligible/calibration/measurement budget consumed
protocol.PG_zero_after_initialization: update PG EMA with zero and use its positive historical value
protocol.gradients: all current trainable parameters; local norms, no cross-rank collective; no .grad mutation
protocol.freeze: after100 eligible calls freeze scales; diagnose to500 eligible calls, then hold last measurements and PG EMA

last_actual_teacher_component_budget.source: native final calibration norms and scales, pre-update4 last active teacher leaf; alpha from sealed pending native material
last_actual_teacher_component_budget.arithmetic_caveat: Component norms are actual autograd measurements before scaling; weighted products/triangle estimates assume linear gradient arithmetic and do not measure combined BF16/DDP vectors or parameter update attribution.

limitations: No new model forward/scoring/GPU task or optimizer update in this analysis.
No qualification weight is transferred to a formal run.
Four updates confirm calibration injection and exact native recovery; they do not establish stability, optimal budget or NAVTEST score gain.
CFM/ODE combined vector norm and its angle to PG are not directly measured by these journal norms; no causal performance attribution.
